listingTitle: Move repeated guards to the shared callee
title: Move repeated guards to the shared callee
why: Equivalent precondition guards added around one project-owned callee in several callers duplicate an invariant and leave sibling callers exposed.
suggestion: Validate the shared precondition once in the callee when it belongs to that operation.
limitations: Requires at least two newly added single-line conditional calls with the same null, empty, or length guard around a directly declared project function.
Caller-specific authorization, feature policy, and intentionally different fallback behavior cannot be inferred.
Runs only for focused changes touching at most five production source files.
